title.en: An Act Amending the third Paragraph of Section Seven Hundred and Ninety of Act Numbered One Hundred and Ninety, as Amended, By Exempting Municipalities and Individuals Declared Insolvent From the Obligation to Pay the Fee in Proceedings for Nonpayment of the Cedula Tax.

text.en:
Section seven hundred and ninety of Act Numbered One hundred and ninety, as amended by Act
Numbered Two thousand and forty-one, is hereby further amended by making the third paragraph thereof read
"Provided, That in prosecutions for infractions of municipal ordinances, the fee shall be one peso and fifty
centavos, and in the proceedings for nonpayment of the cedula tax no fee shall be collected from the
municipalities concerned, nor from the defendants when these latter are declared insolvent."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the same shall take effect on its
passage, in accordance with section one of Act Numbered Nineteen hundred and forty-five of the Philippine
Legislature.
Enacted, November 21, 1913.
